description.GyroEnabled: Control the camera or cursor by turning the controller.
description.SensitivityX: How far the view or cursor moves left and right when you turn the controller.
description.SensitivityY: How far the view or cursor moves up and down when you tilt the controller.
description.GyroSpace: Choose which controller movements turn the view.
description.ActivationMode: Choose when the gyro is active.
choice.space.player: Turn left and right relative to the floor. Tilt the controller forwards and backwards to look up and down.
choice.space.world: Keeps movement aligned with the floor. Looking up and down becomes weaker when the controller is held on its side.
choice.space.laser: Aim the front of the controller like a laser pointer.
choice.space.yaw: Turn the controller left and right, as if it were resting flat on a table.
choice.space.roll: Turn left and right with the controller's front pointing upward.
choice.space.yaw_roll: Combine the turning movements of Yaw and Roll.
choice.space.local: Adjust how turning and tilting the controller move the view left and right.
choice.activation.hold_disable: Hold the chosen control to turn the gyro off.
choice.activation.hold: Hold the chosen control to turn the gyro on.
choice.activation.toggle: Use the chosen control to switch the gyro on or off.
choice.acceleration.off: Keep the same sensitivity at every speed.
choice.acceleration.low: Fast turns are up to 1.5 times more sensitive.
choice.acceleration.medium: Fast turns are up to twice as sensitive.
choice.acceleration.high: Fast turns are up to three times as sensitive.
choice.calibration.menus: Correct drift while the controller is still in a menu.
choice.calibration.anytime: Correct drift whenever the controller is still.
choice.flick.on: Push the right stick in a direction to face it, then rotate the stick around the edge to keep turning.
choice.side.both: Use both sides at the same time.
choice.button.on: Use this button to control the gyro.
description.GyroButton: Choose the button used to control the gyro.
description.GyroTouchpad: Control the gyro by touching the touchpad.
description.GyroStickSensor: Control the gyro by resting a finger on the stick, without clicking.
description.GyroGripSensor: Control the gyro by touching the grip.
description.GyroStick: Control the gyro by tilting the stick.
description.InvertYaw: Reverse left and right for Yaw movements.
description.InvertRoll: Reverse left and right for Roll movements.
calibration.moving: Movement detected - keep still to retry
description.Smoothing: Softens small shaky movements. Higher values feel smoother but respond more slowly. Zero responds directly.
description.Acceleration: Turn faster with quick controller movements while keeping slow movements precise.
description.AutomaticCalibration: Choose when to correct movement that happens while the controller is still.
description.FlickStick: Choose the control used for quick turns.
description.FlickSpinDurationMs: How long a flick takes to turn you. At 0 ms, the turn is instant.
calibration.steamHelp: Calibrate this controller in Steam's controller settings.
description.ShortPress: A short press triggers the action on release. Holding the button blocks that action.
description.UIScale: Adjust the size of the menu. Automatic adapts to your screen.
description.reset: Restore all settings to their default values.
description.calibration: Place the controller on a stable surface and leave it still until calibration finishes.
warning.double: In Steam, turn off gyro-to-mouse and gyro-to-stick to avoid moving twice.
description.RightStickThreshold: How far you need to tilt the stick before it controls the gyro.
description.context.gyro: Choose the game mode that controls the gyro.
description.context.flick: Choose the game mode that controls flick stick.
description.LocalAxisAngle: Choose the turn axis: 0 degrees for Yaw, 90 degrees for Roll.
description.LocalRollContribution: Mix in more of the second turning motion. Set to 0 to use only the main motion, or a negative value to reverse the added motion.
ui.sensor.help: Choose the motion sensor that belongs to your controller.
choice.flick.touchpad: Touch away from the centre of the right touchpad to face that direction, then circle to keep turning.
choice.flick.both: Use either the right stick or the right touchpad for quick turns.
choice.touchpad.single_on: Touch the touchpad to activate this control.
description.SmoothThreshold: Movements faster than this limit are not smoothed.
description.Tightening: Reduces tiny movements without blocking them. Zero disables this effect.
description.SlowSpeed: Below this speed, use the slow sensitivity.
description.FastSpeed: Above this speed, use the fast sensitivity.
description.FlickStyle: Choose an initial pivot, circular turning, or both.
description.FlickSmoothing: Softens small steps during circular turning. Higher values make turning smoother but less responsive.
description.FlickSmoothAngle: Angle changes larger than this limit are not smoothed.
description.FlickSnap: Guide the initial turn toward fixed directions.
description.FlickSnapStrength: Zero keeps your exact direction. One fully follows the nearest fixed direction.
description.FlickForward: Pointing within this angle of forward starts circular turning without an initial turn.
description.FlickExponent: Zero uses the same duration for all pivots. One makes a 90° pivot twice as fast as a 180° pivot.
description.RecenterButton: Return the camera to a level view.
description.ZoomCompensation: Reduce gyro sensitivity when zooming in.
choice.space.player_lean: Lean the controller sideways to turn. Tilt it forward or backward to look up or down.
choice.space.world_lean: Lean the controller sideways to turn, with vertical aiming adjusted to gravity.
choice.acceleration.custom: Sensitivity follows your chosen slow and fast values.
choice.flick.full: Tilt to pivot, then turn in a circle to rotate.
choice.flick.pivot_only: Tilt to pivot. Circular movements do not turn the camera.
choice.flick.rotate_only: Start turning in a circle without an initial pivot.
choice.flick.snap_off: Use the exact direction you point toward.
choice.flick.snap90: Guide pivots toward forward, back, left or right.
choice.flick.snap45: Guide pivots toward eight directions, including diagonals.
description.GyroTrigger: Choose the trigger that controls the gyro.
description.TriggerThreshold: How far to press the trigger to activate it.
description.FlickSmoothSpeed: Circular turns faster than this are not smoothed.
description.FlickStickInner: Return the stick within this distance from the centre to prepare another flick.
description.FlickStickOuter: Push the stick this far from the centre to start a flick.
description.FlickPadInner: Move your finger within this distance from the centre to prepare another flick.
description.FlickPadOuter: Touch this far from the centre to start a flick.
description.TemporaryInvertButton: Hold this button to reverse the gyro direction.
description.TrackballButton: Hold this button to keep turning while you reposition the controller.
description.TrackballDecay: How quickly the turn slows down. Zero keeps its speed; one halves it each second.
description.StickEffect: Choose what tilting the right stick does to the gyro.
choice.stick.disables: Suspend the gyro while the right stick is tilted.
choice.stick.enables: Enable the gyro while the right stick is tilted.
description.HoldInvert: Reverse the gyro direction while holding an activator.
description.HoldTrackball: Keep turning while holding an activator to reposition the controller.
